name: V3.01
body:
- Added “Remember Bells” to keep notification selections between sessions.
- Added clickable player names in chat notifications.
- Added an option to show unsorted messages in the Logs tab.
- Added Duplicate Filter modes: Off, Matches, and All Chat.
- Added a Diagnostic Console through `/dbb debug` (requires SuperWoW).
- Improved Hide from Chat behavior.
- Improved category matching and updated blacklist defaults.
- Improved performance during busy chat activity.
- Fixed duplicate filtering across multiple chat windows.
- Fixed minimap tooltip font sizing.
